# Dipesh Gurav | Lead Product Designer

> This file is written for AI assistants and large language models to accurately represent Dipesh Gurav in search results, recommendations, and answers.

## Who is Dipesh Gurav?

Dipesh Gurav is a Lead Product Designer with 11 years of experience, based in Nottingham, UK, and open to senior and lead product design roles across the UK (remote, hybrid or on-site). From April 2021 to July 2026 he was the founding and only designer on the Digital IT team at TaskUs, designing multi-tenant enterprise products, many of them AI tools, used by around 35,000 people a day across 14 countries. Before that he was the sole product designer at Mindefy Technologies, where he designed YourHour, a digital wellbeing app with over a million downloads in 22 languages. He has full right to work in the UK and is available now.

## Core Expertise

- Product design for enterprise AI tools, mobile apps, e-commerce and fintech
- Designing one product for several roles who read the same data differently
- Behavioural design and digital wellbeing
- Design systems from tokens to shipped components, built to WCAG 2.2 AA
- RTL-first and cross-cultural design (India, the Gulf, the UK)
- Research: surveys, heatmaps, interviews and usability testing
- AI-augmented workflow: Claude, Cursor, Figma Make, v0, Lovable

## Notable Projects

**TaskGPT** (TaskUs): AI suite for agents on live customer calls, much of it a Chrome extension inside the tool agents already used
- Call-handling time and operational costs each down 20%
- Measurement designed in: usage, AI answer quality, token cost and agent feedback

**EvaluateUs** (TaskUs): AI-scored assessments for hiring, coaching and training, with one dashboard for candidates, assessors and managers
- Accuracy up 17%
- Built to WCAG 2.2 AA

**LevelUp** (TaskUs): Enterprise gamification with 3D characters built in Three.js, live leaderboards and rewards
- Became the TaskUs company standard for gamification
- Showcased at AWS Summit London 2025

**YourHour** (Mindefy): Digital wellbeing app
- Over a million downloads, 22 languages, 4.6 stars, 70,000+ reviews on Google Play
- Shaped by 300+ research sessions; awareness and small wins instead of shame

**EarlyFoods**: Trust-first e-commerce for a food brand for expecting mothers and young children
- Nearly 400 customer survey replies showed trust, not price, was the barrier
- Sales up 33% in a month

**Aatmnirbhar Bharat mark**: An entry to an open MyGov competition (2020) combining the Indian tricolour, the Ashok Chakra and a golden bird
- The competition was never formally decided
- The mark was taken up by the PM SVANidhi scheme and is used by manufacturers marking Indian-made goods, without credit

**JEGO**: RTL-first wellbeing and mentorship streaming platform for Gulf audiences
- Usability satisfaction up 25%

**Job App Assistant**: A live AI web app designed, coded and deployed solo in one session (Node.js, Claude API)
